sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "rental"."inventory_id" AS e, "inventory"."store_id" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "rental" JOIN "inventory" ON "inventory"."inventory_id" = "rental"."inventory_id"  GROUP BY "rental"."inventory_id", "inventory"."store_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, SUM("s1"."m1") AS m1 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT SUM("s2"."m1") AS v FROM "s2"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s2"."g" AS g, "s2"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s2"."m1" AS REAL) / "s3"."v") AS m2 FROM "s2" JOIN "s3" ON "s3"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s5" AS (SELECT AVG("s4"."m2") AS v FROM "s4"), "s6" AS (SELECT "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, ("s4"."m2" - "s5"."v") AS m3 FROM "s4" JOIN "s5" ON "s5"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s4"."m2" > "s5"."v") SELECT SUM("s6"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s6"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s6"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s6"
